entries.title: Guest scheduler: one booking link that checks every host's calendar
entries.summary: A **booking link** for speakers, podcast guests and interviewees that checks every host's Google Calendar together, so the guest only sees times when all hosts are free. Guests see times in their own time zone (with a switcher); the default zone for working hours is the first host's calendar zone. A booking puts one event on everyone's calendar with Zoom or Google Meet and **reschedule and cancel links** that work without signing in, and moves the guest's Contact to **Confirmed** in the pipeline. Set it up from Claude, ChatGPT or the API.

where.path: Assistant (MCP) or API: CRM → Guest scheduler

entries.use_case: A team running a show or webinar series with two hosts sends guests one link instead of trading emails; the guest books a time both hosts are free, everyone gets the invite, and the CRM shows the guest as Confirmed.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer asks for a HubSpot- or Calendly-style booking link for speakers or guests, especially with more than one host.
internal.who_should_get_it: CRM customers who book speakers, podcast or webinar guests with two or more hosts.
internal.gotchas: Each host connects their own Google Calendar (connect_scheduler_calendar) before the link takes bookings. Zoom meetings need meeting scopes on the org's Zoom app; without them the booking still goes through with no Zoom link. A release template is never sent automatically.

draft.why_use_it: Book guests with several hosts without the back-and-forth, and keep the CRM pipeline current automatically.

entries.title: Cvent: any dropdown field can set the session category
entries.summary: A dropdown field you created, not just **Track**, **Format** or **Level**, can now fill a Cvent session's category. Sessionboard sends the Cvent session category with the same name as the selected value, and the sync log names any value that has no matching category in Cvent.

where.path: Apps → Cvent → Event mapping → Map Session Fields → category

entries.use_case: If you sort sessions in Cvent by your own Session Format or Type field, map it to category and Cvent gets each session's category automatically, so nobody has to set it by hand in Cvent.

cs_action.note: Tell customers who map a custom dropdown to Cvent category (ACA, SB-11586) to add each dropdown value as a session category in Cvent, then re-sync.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a Cvent customer says Category stays blank in Cvent even though they mapped a field to it.
internal.who_should_get_it: Cvent customers who map one of their own dropdown fields to Cvent's category.
internal.staff_path: Event → Apps → Cvent → Event mapping → Map Session Fields
internal.gotchas: Sessionboard never creates session categories in Cvent. A value with no matching category leaves Category unset, and the sync log shows a [CATEGORY] warning naming it. Before this fix, a custom dropdown mapped to category was dropped with no error.
